RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: The City of Pasco operates under a Council-Manager system. Mayor David Milne and Mayor Pro-Tem Charles Grimm were appointed by the City Council on August 19, 2025, following the resignation of former Mayor Pete Serrano. The District 4 Council Member position is currently vacant as of September 17, 2025, with applications having closed on September 2, 2025, and interviews scheduled for September 15, 2025. An appointment for District 4 is pending or has recently occurred but is not reflected in the provided search results.
